answer: The reveal must open the same garden hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the basalt gate. Copying becomes a race the adversary always loses, and producing 93 original texts is the only way to fill 99 aliases; the meadow log preserves both halves. Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. That is 29 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
